What was wrong

Default Mermaid uses spline curves (curve: basis) and a dense graph layout. With many cross-file edges, connectors looked like tangled power lines.

What we did

  1. ELK layout — hierarchical placement instead of cramming nodes together
  2. Linear connectors — curve: linear gives right-angle / orthogonal paths (no splines)
  3. Simpler sources — fewer cross-edges:
    • Master map → zone-level boxes (not every sub-engine)
    • Credit model → linear PD → LGD → EAD → ECL chains
    • QE → three parallel column subgraphs
